title: Snow-makers
description: 完整答案表、全文段落速覽，以及逐題 Skim、Scan、Read、同義改寫與中伏位分析。

questions.translation: 人工過程，天然產品目標段落：Paragraph C

blocks.text: “The snow gun works very differently from a natural weather system, but it accomplishes exactly the same thing.”
snow gun 的運作方式和天然天氣系統非常不同，但它達成的結果完全一樣。
“The droplets are then blown out of the gun, and if the outside temperature is below 0°C, ice crystals will form and then make snowflakes in the same way as natural snow.”
這些水滴之後會從機器中噴出；如果外面溫度低於 0°C，ice crystals 便會形成，然後以和天然雪相同的方式形成 snowflakes。
只看首尾句，這段已經很清楚：方法是 artificial，結果是 natural-like snow。第一句比較 snow gun和 natural weather system；最後一句說它最後形成 snowflakes in the same way as natural snow。
“works very differently from a natural weather system”
“make snowflakes in the same way as natural snow”
“The device basically works by combining water and air.”
這個裝置基本上透過混合水和空氣運作。
“When the compressed air passes through the hose into the gun, it atomises the water…”
當壓縮空氣經喉管進入 snow gun，它會把水霧化。
這些句子說明人工過程：water pumping station、air compressor、compressed air、atomises the water。段末則回到 natural product：ice crystals 和 snowflakes。heading ix 正好概括「人工機械過程製造出類似天然雪的結果」。
Artificial process= snow gun works differently / combining water and air / compressed air atomises water Natural product= ice crystals / snowflakes / in the same way as natural snow
ii “Modifications to the design of the snow gun” 有一定吸引力，因為這段提到 hoses、gun、compressor。可是段落沒有講設計被改良，焦點在 snow gun 如何模仿自然造雪結果。真正控制答案的是第一句的 “works very differently” 和 “accomplishes exactly the same thing”。

questions.answer: iii — The need for different varieties of snow
questions.answerKey: iii — The need for different varieties of snow
questions.translation: 需要不同種類的雪目標段落：Paragraph D

blocks.text: “Snow-makers often talk about dry snow and wet snow.”
造雪人員經常談 dry snow 和 wet snow。
“Many resorts build up the snow depth this way once or twice a year, and then regularly coat the trails with a layer of dry snow throughout the winter.”
很多滑雪場一年一兩次用這種方法增加 snow depth，然後在整個冬天定期在滑道上覆蓋一層dry snow。
第一句直接提出兩種雪：dry snow 和 wet snow。最後一句指出兩者有不同用法：wet snow 用來增加深度，dry snow 用來覆蓋表層。這段全段都在解釋不同種類的雪為何有不同功能。
“Dry snow has a relatively low water content”
“resort owners also use denser, wet snow underneath the dry snow”
“Dry snow has a relatively low water content, so it is very light and powdery.”
Dry snow 的含水量相對低，所以很輕、呈粉狀。
“However, on slopes which receive heavy use, resort owners also use denser, wet snow underneath the dry snow.”
不過，在使用量大的斜坡上，滑雪場負責人也會在 dry snow 下方使用較密實的 wet snow。
這裡清楚展示兩種雪的不同需要：dry snow 適合表面滑行和鋪平；wet snow 較密實，用作底層，幫助支撐高使用量斜坡。
different varieties of snow= dry snow and wet snow need for different varieties= dry snow for surface / wet snow underneath for heavy-use slopes
vii “Converting wet snow to dry snow” 會吸引學生，因為段內同時出現 dry snow 和 wet snow。
可是原文沒有說把濕雪轉成乾雪，只說兩種雪各有用途。題目要概括整段，iii 最穩。

questions.answer: viii — New method for calculating modifications
questions.answerKey: viii — New method for calculating modifications
questions.translation: 計算調整的新方法目標段落：Paragraph E

blocks.text: “The wetness of snow depends on the temperature and humidity outside, as well as the size of the water droplets launched by the gun.”
雪的濕度取決於外面的 temperature 和 humidity，也取決於 snow gun 噴出的水滴大小。
“Many ski slopes now do this with a central computer system that is connected to weather-reading stations all over the slope.”
很多滑雪場現在用中央電腦系統來做這件事，該系統連接斜坡各處的 weather-reading stations。
首句指出 snow consistency 受天氣和 droplets size 影響；最後一句說現在用中央電腦系統和天氣讀取站處理調整。段落功能是：如何按外界條件計算和調整 water / air 比例。
“adjust the proportions of water and air”
“Snow-makers have to adjust the proportions of water and air in their snow guns to produce the right snow consistency for the outdoor weather conditions.”
造雪人員必須調整 snow guns 中水和空氣的比例，才能因應戶外天氣條件製造出合適的 snow consistency。
這句中的 adjust the proportions 就是 modifications。下一句 “central computer system” 則說明新的方法。電腦連接 weather-reading stations，代表它能根據斜坡不同位置的天氣資料輔助調整。
modifications= adjust the proportions of water and air calculating method= central computer system connected to weather-reading stations
ii “Modifications to the design of the snow gun” 也有 modifications，但錯在 design。Paragraph E沒有說 snow gun 的結構設計被改動；它講的是根據天氣調整水和空氣比例。

questions.translation: 考慮生態／環境代價目標段落：Paragraph F

blocks.text: “But man-made snow makes heavy demands on the environment.”
但是，人造雪對環境有很大要求。
“However, considerable amounts of energy are needed to run the large air-compressing pumps, and the diesel engines which run them also cause air pollution.”
可是，運行大型空氣壓縮泵需要大量能源，而驅動它們的柴油引擎也會造成空氣污染。
首尾句直接顯示段落方向：人造雪有環境成本。第一句是總論，最後一句列出 energy use 和 air pollution。中間還有大量用水和水庫循環使用。
“It takes about 275,000 litres of water to create a blanket of snow covering a 60 × 60-metre area.”
要製造一層覆蓋 60 × 60 米範圍的雪，約需要 275,000 公升水。
這些都是 ecological costs：耗水、耗能、污染。Paragraph F 雖然也說 run-off water 可回流到reservoirs，讓 resort 重複用水，但整體段落重點仍然落在環境負擔。
ecological costs= heavy demands on the environment / water use / energy use / air pollution
iv “Local concern over environmental issues” 方向接近，但原文沒有 local residents、public concern、campaigns 或 complaints。這段談的是客觀環境成本，沒有談地方居民的反應，所以 i更準確。

questions.answer: vi — Applications beyond the ski slopes
questions.answerKey: vi — Applications beyond the ski slopes
questions.translation: 滑雪斜坡以外的應用目標段落：Paragraph G

blocks.text: “Because of the expense of making snow, ski resorts have to balance the cost of running the machines with the benefits of extending the ski season…”
由於造雪成本高，滑雪場必須平衡機器運行成本和延長滑雪季節所帶來的收益。
“And another important application of man-made snow is its use in tests that aircraft must undergo in order to ensure that they can function safely in extreme conditions.”
人造雪另一個重要用途，是用於 aircraft 必須接受的測試，以確保它們能在極端條件下安全運作。
首句先接續滑雪場成本，第二句開始轉向 “other uses”。最後一句落在 aircraft tests，已經離開 ski slopes。這段中段還提到 agriculture 和 movie productions，因此 heading vi 能覆蓋全段後半的主要發展。
“man-made snow has a number of other uses as well”
“But man-made snow has a number of other uses as well.”
但人造雪還有許多其他用途。

之後文章列出三類： farmers use man-made snow to provide insulation for winter crops movie productions use snow-making machines aircraft tests use man-made snow for extreme conditions這三個例子都在 ski resorts 以外，所以 heading vi 是段落主功能。
applications beyond the ski slopes= other uses as well / farmers / movie productions / aircraft tests
段首有 “expense of making snow”，容易令人以為答案要選 cost-related heading。但 list 中沒有單純「經濟成本」heading，而且段落很快轉到 “other uses”。段落真正展開的內容是多種非滑雪用途。

questions.translation: 請依照下方步驟完成定位、細讀與答案判斷。

blocks.text: “The snow gun works very differently from a natural weather system, but it accomplishes exactly the same thing.”
snow gun 的運作方式和天然天氣系統不同，但它達成完全相同的結果。
“The droplets are then blown out of the gun, and if the outside temperature is below 0°C, ice crystals will form and then make snowflakes in the same way as natural snow.”
水滴之後從機器中噴出；如果外面溫度低於 0°C，便會形成 ice crystals，再像天然雪一樣形成snowflakes。
這段是 snow gun 運作程序段，所以 diagram labels 必定主要來自 Paragraph C。
雖然你貼出的圖沒有顯示，但 snow gun 圖通常會標示 air compressor、hose、water 和出口粒子。Q6 的標準答案是 compressed，表示圖上很可能已給出 “air” 或指向 air hose，需要填形容詞。
“When the compressed air passes through the hose into the gun, it atomises the water…”
當壓縮空氣經喉管進入 snow gun，它會把水霧化。
這句中 “compressed air” 是固定搭配。若圖中空格在 air 前，答案只需填 compressed；若完整標籤要求名詞短語，compressed air 也來自原文。不過公開版本答案表給的是 compressed，表示圖上應該已有 air。
答案形式compressed = 1 word，符合 NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS。

questions.translation: 請依照下方步驟完成定位、細讀與答案判斷。

blocks.text: “The snow gun works very differently from a natural weather system, but it accomplishes exactly the same thing.”
snow gun 的運作方式和天然天氣系統不同，但達成相同結果。
“The droplets are then blown out of the gun…”
這些水滴之後會從機器中噴出。
從首尾句可見，Paragraph C 會描述水和空氣如何變成 snowflakes。Q7 若在水被霧化後的位置，答案應找 water 變成甚麼。
題目圖若標在 snow gun 出口附近、snowflakes 形成前，最可能對應 “water splits up into tiny droplets”。
“…it atomises the water—that is, it disrupts the stream so that the water splits up into tiny droplets.”
它會把水霧化；也就是說，它打散水流，使水分裂成 tiny droplets。
這句把 atomises 解釋得很清楚：水流被打散，形成 tiny droplets。圖中 Q7 多半標示從 gun 噴出的細小水滴，因此答案是 (tiny) droplets。括號表示 tiny 可填可不填；最穩陣可填 tiny droplets，因為兩個字仍符合限制。
答案形式tiny droplets = 2 words，符合 NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS。
droplets = 1 word，也符合；標準答案通常接受 (tiny) droplets。

questions.translation: 請依照下方步驟完成定位、細讀與答案判斷。

blocks.text: “The snow gun works very differently from a natural weather system, but it accomplishes exactly the same thing.”
snow gun 的運作方式和天然天氣系統不同，但它達成同一結果。
“…if the outside temperature is below 0°C, ice crystals will form and then make snowflakes in the same way as natural snow.”
如果外面溫度低於 0°C，ice crystals 會形成，然後像天然雪一樣形成 snowflakes。
最後一句已經直接包含 Q8 的答案。diagram 若標在 droplets 之後、snowflakes 之前，答案就是ice crystals。
Q8 在流程上應位於 tiny droplets 之後。掃描 Paragraph C 的程序順序：compressed air →atomises water → tiny droplets → below 0°C → ice crystals → snowflakes。
“…if the outside temperature is below 0°C, ice crystals will form and then make snowflakes…”
如果外面溫度低於 0°C，ice crystals 會形成，然後形成 snowflakes。
這裡 “will form” 是核心動詞，表示 droplets 在低溫下先變成 ice crystals，之後才形成 snowflakes。因此答案是 ice crystals。
答案形式ice crystals = 2 words，符合 NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS。
單複數要保留 plural，因為原文是 crystals，而且圖上通常指多個晶體。

questions.prompt: “Dry snow is used to give slopes a level surface, while wet snow is used to increase the 9______ on busy slopes.”
questions.translation: Dry snow 用來令斜坡表面平整；wet snow 則用來增加繁忙斜坡上的 ______。

blocks.text: “Snow-makers often talk about dry snow and wet snow.”
造雪人員經常談 dry snow 和 wet snow。
“Many resorts build up the snow depth this way once or twice a year, and then regularly coat the trails with a layer of dry snow throughout the winter.”
很多滑雪場一年一兩次用這種方法增加 snow depth，然後整個冬天定期在滑道上覆蓋一層 dry snow。
段落首尾句已經指出 dry snow / wet snow 的不同用途。題目同樣比較 dry snow 和 wet snow，因此 Paragraph D 是直接定位段。
“this powdery snow can be produced to give the ski slopes a level surface”
“use denser, wet snow underneath the dry snow”
“Many resorts build up the snow depth this way once or twice a year…”
很多滑雪場一年一兩次用這種方法增加 snow depth。
題目中的 “increase” 對應原文 “build up”。“busy slopes” 對應 “slopes which receive heavy use”。
空格前是 “increase the”，所以需要名詞。標準答案填 depth。
increase = build up busy slopes = slopes which receive heavy use depth = snow depth答案形式depth = 1 word，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。
“snow depth” 也來自原文，但標準答案通常填 depth，因為題目整句已經在談 snow。

questions.prompt: “To calculate the required snow consistency, the 10 ______ of the atmosphere must first be measured.”
questions.translation: 為了計算所需的 snow consistency，必須先量度大氣的 ______。

blocks.text: “The wetness of snow depends on the temperature and humidity outside, as well as the size of the water droplets launched by the gun.”
雪的濕度取決於外面的 temperature 和 humidity，也取決於 snow gun 噴出的水滴大小。
“Many ski slopes now do this with a central computer system that is connected to weather-reading stations all over the slope.”
很多滑雪場現在用中央電腦系統來做這件事，該系統連接斜坡各處的 weather-reading stations。
這段直接處理 snow consistency 和天氣條件，所以 Q10 位置非常明確。
“The wetness of snow depends on the temperature and humidity outside…”
雪的濕度取決於外面的 temperature 和 humidity。
題目把 “outside” 改寫成 “of the atmosphere”，把 “depends on” 改成 “must first be measured”。
要計算 consistency，先要知道外界天氣條件，尤其 temperature and humidity。

atmosphere = outside / outdoor weather conditions calculate required snow consistency = produce the right snow consistency temperature and humidity = temperature and humidity答案形式temperature and humidity = 3 words。
題目限制是 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS，所以完全符合。

questions.prompt: “The machinery used to make snow consumes a great deal of 11 ______, damaging the environment.”
questions.translation: 造雪機械消耗大量 ______，對環境造成損害。

blocks.text: “But man-made snow makes heavy demands on the environment.”
人造雪對環境有很大要求。
“However, considerable amounts of energy are needed to run the large air-compressing pumps, and the diesel engines which run them also cause air pollution.”
可是，運行大型空氣壓縮泵需要大量 energy，而驅動它們的柴油引擎也造成空氣污染。
首尾句直接顯示 environmental cost。題目中的 “damaging the environment” 對應首句 “heavy demands on the environment” 和末句 “air pollution”。
“However, considerable amounts of energy are needed to run the large air-compressing pumps…”
然而，運行大型空氣壓縮泵需要相當大量的 energy。
題目中的 “consumes a great deal of” 對應原文 “considerable amounts of … are needed”。空格需要不可數名詞，所以 energy 正確。

consumes a great deal of = considerable amounts of … are needed machinery used to make snow = large air-compressing pumps damaging the environment = cause air pollution / heavy demands on the environment答案形式energy = 1 word，符合限制。

questions.prompt: “Artificial snow is used in agriculture as a type of 12 ______ for plants in cold conditions.”
questions.translation: 人造雪在農業中可作為寒冷環境下植物的一種 ______。

blocks.text: “Because of the expense of making snow, ski resorts have to balance the cost of running the machines with the benefits of extending the ski season…”
由於造雪成本高，滑雪場要平衡機器運行成本和延長滑雪季節的收益。
“And another important application of man-made snow is its use in tests that aircraft must undergo…”
人造雪另一個重要用途，是用於 aircraft 必須接受的測試。
Paragraph G 是人造雪其他用途段。題目說 agriculture，對應段中 farmers / winter crops。
“A layer of snow keeps a lot of the Earth’s heat from escaping into the atmosphere, so farmers often use man-made snow to provide insulation for winter crops.”
一層雪可以防止大量地熱散失到大氣中，所以農民常用人造雪為冬季作物提供 insulation。
題目把 “farmers” 改成 “agriculture”，把 “winter crops” 改成 “plants in cold conditions”。“provide insulation” 直接給出答案。
agriculture = farmers plants in cold conditions = winter crops as a type of insulation = provide insulation答案形式insulation = 1 word，符合限制。

questions.prompt: “Artificial snow may also be used in carrying out safety checks on 13 ______.”
questions.translation: 人造雪也可用於對 ______ 進行安全檢查。

blocks.text: “Because of the expense of making snow, ski resorts have to balance the cost of running the machines with the benefits of extending the ski season…”
由於造雪成本高，滑雪場要平衡機器運行成本和延長滑雪季節的收益。
“And another important application of man-made snow is its use in tests that aircraft must undergo in order to ensure that they can function safely in extreme conditions.”
人造雪另一個重要用途，是用於 aircraft 必須接受的測試，以確保它們能在極端條件下安全運作。
最後一句已經直接對應 Q13。題目中的 safety checks 改寫了 tests + function safely。
“And another important application of man-made snow is its use in tests that aircraft must undergo in order to ensure that they can function safely in extreme conditions.”
人造雪另一個重要應用，是用於 aircraft 必須接受的測試，以確保它們在極端環境下也能安全運作。
題目中的 “safety checks” 概括原文 “tests … ensure that they can function safely”。被測試的對象是 aircraft，所以答案是 aircraft。
safety checks = tests … ensure that they can function safely on aircraft = aircraft must undergo extreme conditions = cold / snowy testing context答案形式aircraft = 1 word，符合限制。
注意 aircraft 單複數同形，不要自行改成 aircrafts。

最後整理：高頻同義改寫Artificial process, natural product= snow gun works differently from natural weather system, but makes snowflakes like natural snow different varieties of snow= dry snow and wet snow adjust snow consistency= adjust the proportions of water and air ecological costs= heavy demands on the environment / water use / energy use / air pollution applications beyond ski slopes= farmers, movie productions, aircraft tests compressed air= air from an air compressor tiny droplets= water splits up into tiny droplets ice crystals= crystals form when outside temperature is below 0°C increase the depth= build up the snow depth temperature and humidity= outdoor weather conditions energy consumption= considerable amounts of energy are needed insulation= keeping Earth’s heat from escaping safety checks on aircraft= tests aircraft must undergo to function safely in extreme conditions

paragraphOverview.title: Skim Roadmap：先用首尾句建立全文地圖
paragraphOverview.intro: 先掌握每段的功能與主旨，再進入逐題定位和細讀分析。

paragraphs.summary: 只看第一句，讀者會先知道 skiing 已經成為大生意，ski slopes 在二十世紀初至中期因滑雪流行而變得極有利可圖。最後一句說，snow guns 已成為世界大多數滑雪場的標準設備，令很多滑雪場一年可開放四個月或更久。首尾句顯示這段功能是提出問題與解法：滑雪場依賴天氣，但 snow gun 讓它們能在人造雪支援下延長營業時間。

第一句說，天然天氣系統形成的雪來自大氣中的水蒸氣。最後一句說，snowflake 變重後會落向地面。首尾句已清楚顯示這段在解釋 natural snow 的形成過程。中間會按順序說明：water vapour凝結成 droplets，低溫下 droplets 凍成 tiny ice crystals，更多水粒附在 crystal 上，最後形成snowflake。這段是例題 Paragraph B 對應 heading x 的原因。

第一句說 snow gun 的運作方式和天然天氣系統很不同，但達成的結果完全一樣。最後一句說，如果外面溫度低於 0°C，ice crystals 會形成，然後像天然雪一樣形成 snowflakes。首尾句顯示這段重點是人工過程製造天然結果。中間會交代 water hose、air compressor、compressed air、atomises the water、tiny droplets 等步驟。這段是 heading、diagram labels 的核心段。
